newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman bourse retraces some of previous weeks' gains.
newsitem.headline: Oman bourse retraces some of previous weeks' gains.

text.p: Shares on the Oman stock exchange retraced some of the previous weeks' gains in the week to Wednesday as turnover slipped in moderate trade, the Muscat Securities Market said.

The stock exchange index shed 10.07 points to close at 318.07. The total value of trade dropped to 29.4 million rials ($78 million) from 50.5 million a week earlier. Turnover also eased to 7.7 million shares, down from 12.9 million.
Some 84 stocks were traded in the week, of which 12 rose, 55 declined and 17 were unchanged.
Among the week's busiest stocks was the National Bank of Oman, which rose to 8.510 rials from 8.000 rials last week. Some 623,000 National Bank of Oman shares worth 5.14 million rials were traded.
Bank Muscat al-Ahli al-Omani was also actively traded, with 489,000 shares worth 3.48 million rials changing hands. The stock closed at 7.050 rials from 7.160 a week earlier.
Al Ahlia Portfolio Securities dipped to 10.300 rials from 10.650.

Banking and investment company stocks dominated the market, accounting for 83 percent of trade, followed by the services sector with eight percent, industrials with seven and insurance stocks with two percent. ($1=0.377 rials)
